svg.text: Depth and bottom photos: data collection
Side view of the kickboard set-up (A), tracks across a corridor (B) and the reference photo for clock synchronisation (C). Not to scale.
A · Side view: echosounder and camera under the kickboard
B · Plan view: tracks across the corridor
solid: tracks from deep water to the shore · dashed: tracks along the shore at different depths
dots: depth points and photos along the tracks · cover all depths and bottom types
C · Reference photo for clock sync
applied to all photos in processing
take one at the start and one at the end
